design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — placed_account_servicing task 1 (medical collection paid down below the credit-reporting floor)

[Step 0 — draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 6, 4]}. Portal debit-card ceiling takes 4 factors, portal credit-card ceiling 6, reporting-floor pay-down 4. Occupied by task 0: account_ext_phone_debit_card_ceiling, account_ext_phone_credit_card_ceiling, account_ext_portal_bank_debit_ceiling and their tools (phone-desk card payments, portal bank debit). Claimed here, disjoint: account_ext_portal_debit_card_ceiling (make_portal_debit_card_payment_fc4d38a9, user), account_ext_portal_credit_card_ceiling (make_portal_credit_card_payment_7a2662c6, user), account_ext_reporting_floor_paydown (take_phone_bank_payment_d463b192, agent). The root quantity differs from task 0: it is not a ceiling but the amount that brings the reportable balance below the debt type's reporting floor, so it moves with every earlier payment of the day; the card ceilings here are the self-service portal's, read from different evidence (financial-assistance decision, debt type, rebills, disputes). Every extended policy of the difficulty is now claimed (3 + 3), none idle.
Only payments: refund and return amounts are fixed by base, so every problem is a consumer payment whose amount a policy computes. Account money events trigger client-ledger bookings; the task tools write only account tables.

[Design thesis] Surface goal: "I want to get it under that line today" (St. Brigid hospital bill; medical collections under 500 are not reported). Core scored parameter: the phone bank-debit pay-down (root). Between goal and root the root's own rule says the pay-down is not fixed until the day's portal credit-card payment has been made where she pays part by credit card through the portal (she chooses cards on the website when asked), and the portal credit-card rule says that ceiling is fixed only after the day's portal debit-card payment. Neither card payment exists on 2026-10-07 at the opening. Depth 2 hops; breadth: return history, card and bank windows, rebill and insurance credit, dispute and verification, the Financial Assistance Review Hold and its denied decision (hardship category), return reasons, the final-bill age, the debt type's reporting minimum, stage limits.

[Problem-tree card]
root: account_ext_reporting_floor_paydown (agent tool take_phone_bank_payment_d463b192).
edge A: reporting_floor_paydown -> portal_credit_card_ceiling; value_input; gate card_cushion; form action; sentence (negated): "Where the consumer also pays part of it by credit card through the payment portal, the reporting-floor pay-down is not fixed until the day's portal credit-card payment has been made." fallback_reason: a credit-card payment dated the handling date is also booked by the phone desk's credit-card ceiling write, so the state does not single out one write. Opening false: only credit-card payment initial_state.account_transactions.775c04df-b973-48c3-9f3c-fdf319ca7a4c dated 2026-09-22. Resolving write: step 10 (user).
edge B: portal_credit_card_ceiling -> portal_debit_card_ceiling; value_input; gate portal_credit_counted; form action; sentence (affirmative): "When a consumer who also pays by debit card through the payment portal is paying an account down in one day, the portal credit-card ceiling of the day is fixed only after the day's portal debit-card payment has been made." fallback_reason: the phone desk's debit-card write also books debit-card payments. Opening false: only debit-card payment d7b0c295-910c-4842-bd8d-da28342fc6ce dated 2026-09-03. Resolving write: step 8 (user).
Four-point test on both: ordering connective (not ... until / only after); a plainly named business action, no tool/id/snake token; hard strength; scope limited to a consumer paying by those portal cards. Charter directions: task 0 and task 1 each carry one affirmative and one negated sentence.
Order: portal debit (8) -> portal credit (10) -> phone bank (12); chain, no parallel edges. value_input edges 2. User writes: steps 8 and 10.
Deletion sensitivity: skip step 8 -> credit ceiling 1720.0 instead of 460.00; skip step 10 -> pay-down 913.49 instead of 478.49.
Derivation: root sentence + ledger (no credit-card payment dated 2026-10-07) + the portal credit-card policy's own rule (the consumer makes one portal credit-card payment equal to its ceiling) -> that payment; its sentence + ledger (no debit-card payment dated 2026-10-07) + the portal debit-card rule -> the portal debit-card payment. All three are synchronous charges/debits at frozen_time; no waiting event.

[Base-invariant card] Subject account_payment_posted: allocation_target_open_and_undisputed and payment_account_open (status active after the hold ended 2026-09-27) hold; electronic_block_elapsed holds because no block is in force (one return, 2026-07-15, in the 180-day lookback, Primary threshold 2; were a block running it would last through 2026-10-13, electronic payments accepted from 2026-10-14). Base limits after the writes: card payments in the 30 days ending 2026-10-07 = 200 + 960 + 460 = 1620.00 <= 10000.00; each card payment <= 5000.00; bank debit 478.49 <= 25000.00. Overwrite declared on account_evt_payment_channels for the card limit sentence (two portal ceilings) and the ACH limit sentence (pay-down). The reporting floor is account_evt_credit_reporting's reporting_min_balance_by_debt_type for the debt type (medical 500, auto/student 250, others 100), with no age condition, so the extended rule no longer departs from the base minimum; whether a debt past its obsolescence date can be reported at all is left to the base credit reporting rule, which the pay-down rule says it does not restate; the medical first-report wait (365 days from 2025-10-20 -> 2026-10-20) means the account cannot yet carry a tradeline, which is why the pay-down still matters today.

[Business-object card] Target placed account 546397ce-71f0-4c5b-bfcd-8bce1eac28cd (St. Brigid Medical Center, SB-1772045), the consumer's only placed account. Ledger v1..v9, case events d1 (dispute) and d2 (verification answering d1), hold b34439b7-54cf-4520-8546-f07165047db5 and its events e1..e5 (e4 = decision denied). All rows carry account_id 546397ce-71f0-4c5b-bfcd-8bce1eac28cd; the return v5 points to v4; d2 names d1.

[Factor card]
portal debit-card ceiling (960.00; baseline_result 2058.49): return limit (1 return -> 1600.00; baseline 10000 -> 2058.49); assistance (latest decision denied and most recent FA hold ending 2026-09-27, 0 months -> 0.60; baseline -> 1600.00); exposure basis (method: a credit-card payment in the last month and a bank debit in three months -> every card and bank-debit payment of the month = 200.00; near-miss 2026-09-03 debit one month and four days back; baseline debit of the month 0.00 -> 1160.00); clean record (no debit return and a debit payment in three months -> 200.00; baseline 0 -> 760.00).
portal credit-card ceiling (460.00; baseline_result 1098.49): bill limit (medical, final bill 203 days -> 3000.00; baseline -> 1098.49); assistance (denied -> 0.70; baseline -> 1098.49); counting basis (return + debit today -> two-month cards 1460.00; baseline credit of the month 200.00 -> 1098.49); appeal cushion (rebill 2026-05-28 + insurance credit -> 120.00; baseline -> 580.00); dispute history (insurance_should_have_paid dispute + verification in six months -> 0.90; baseline -> 670.00); steady use (3 card payments, none returned -> 150.00; baseline -> 310.00).
reporting-floor pay-down (478.49; baseline_result 138.50): margin (denied decision recorded 2026-08-28, 1 month -> 25.00; baseline 0.01 -> 453.50); provisional add-back (method: the only return is nsf, so only bank debits of two months are added back -> 250.00; baseline nothing -> 228.49); card cushion (credit-card payment today, no chargeback -> 25.00; baseline 0 -> 453.49); recoupment reserve (insurance credit 2026-08-14 within three months and rebill within six -> 40.00; baseline 0 -> 438.49). The reporting floor (medical 500.00) is the base minimum and no longer a factor.
Cross-difficulty factors: portal_debit_assistance, portal_credit_assistance, paydown_margin_rule (hardship holds and recorded decisions). Multi-source: portal_debit_assistance, portal_debit_exposure_basis, portal_debit_clean_record, portal_credit_counting_basis, portal_credit_appeal_cushion, portal_credit_dispute_history, portal_credit_steady_use, paydown_provisional_addback, paydown_card_cushion, paydown_recoupment_reserve. No outcome stamp is read.

[World rows] customer 7193078e-dabe-49fa-a2d1-c8f09a3da3d5; account 546397ce-71f0-4c5b-bfcd-8bce1eac28cd; 9 ledger rows (balance 2058.49 = 3184.27 + 286.40 + 250.00 - 1662.18); 2 case events; hold b34439b7-54cf-4520-8546-f07165047db5 with 5 events. Removing v5 removes the return tiers and the add-back; removing e4 removes all three assistance/margin tiers; removing d1/d2 the dispute factor; removing v2 the appeal cushion and the rebilled recoupment tier; removing v7 the recoupment reserve; removing v6 the add-back amount and the bank leg of the debit exposure tier. Automatic clauses: no electronic block, supplemental window long closed, hold ended (no running hold duties), verification already mailed (no hold), no tradeline yet (medical wait to 2026-10-20). The placing client agreement is outside this task's closure (no decision reads it), so agreement_id is left empty in the seed rows.

[Persona] Wilhelmina volunteers the goal and the reason (mortgage, the 500 line). Identity (2165551729, 1990-11-02, 1863, 44120) only when asked; how she pays only when asked (cards herself on the website, the checking-account part by phone); she runs each portal payment the agent sets up with the stated reference and amount, authorizes the phone debit when asked, and closes when told it went through. She never knows a figure or an order and never corrects.

[Standard solution] find_customers(2165551729) -> verify(phone, 1990-11-02) -> find_placed_accounts -> find_account_transactions(546397ce-71f0-4c5b-bfcd-8bce1eac28cd) -> find_account_case_events(546397ce-71f0-4c5b-bfcd-8bce1eac28cd) -> find_hardship_holds(546397ce-71f0-4c5b-bfcd-8bce1eac28cd) -> find_hardship_hold_events(546397ce-71f0-4c5b-bfcd-8bce1eac28cd) -> unlock_user/call_user portal debit 960.00 -> unlock_user/call_user portal credit 460.00 -> unlock/call phone bank 478.49. Terminal balance due 160.00.

[Verification run] Authoring replay on initial_state + earlier gold writes with check_compute's evaluator: portal debit 960.0 (baselines 2058.49 / 1600.0 / 1160.0 / 760.0; all 2058.49); portal credit 460.0 (1098.49 / 1098.49 / 1098.49 / 580.0 / 670.0 / 310.0; all 1098.49; without step 8 1720.0); pay-down 478.49 (453.5 / 228.49 / 453.49 / 438.49; all 138.5; without step 10 913.49). Receipts: balance_due_after 1098.49, 638.49, 160.0. Per-task gates check_extended / check_task_tools / replay_tasks / check_solvability / check_compute / check_grounding / check_cross_fire --task 1: OK.

[Easy mistakes] using the base 500 floor without the margin, add-back and reserves (138.50); working the pay-down before the card payments (913.49); counting only last month's debit payments (0.00) when a credit card and a recent bank debit are in use; adding card payments back although no unauthorized_debit or stop_payment return exists; forgetting the insurance-denial rebill or the June dispute; using the hold's approval (decision_date 2026-08-03) instead of the client's recorded assistance decision (denied).

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the published rules, the tool schemas and the finder rows, the order portal debit -> portal credit -> phone bank and the figures 960.00 / 460.00 / 478.49 follow; the only caller inputs are identity, her choice of instruments and her authorization. Agreement with gold: yes.


[Round 2 rework — audit audits/policy_task/placed_account_servicing (1.md, _difficulty.md)]
- F5 / 1.md finding 1: portal_debit_window (look-back length by debt type) replaced by portal_debit_exposure_basis, whose tiers change which channels are counted (all card and bank debits / debit and credit cards / debit cards only). Portal debit ceiling 860.00 -> 960.00; portal credit ceiling 560.00 -> 460.00 (counted 1460.00, balance 1098.49).
- F5 / 1.md finding 2: paydown_provisional_addback now changes which channels are treated as provisional, decided by the reason of the returns in six months (unauthorized_debit or stop_payment -> bank and card payments of two months; nsf or account_closed -> bank payments only; none -> nothing). Here the return is nsf, so 250.00 as before.
- F3: the reporting floor no longer has an age tier; it is the base minimum for the debt type (non-factor binding), and the obsolescence question is left to the base credit reporting rule. To keep the drawn 4 factors the pay-down gained paydown_recoupment_reserve (insurer recoupment after a recent insurance payment), and paydown_margin_rule now reads the recency of the denied decision rather than the return count (no condition shared with the add-back). Pay-down 438.49 -> 478.49; terminal balance 160.00.
- F1 / F2: the portal debit assistance tier reads the latest recorded decision and the most recent Financial Assistance Review Hold ending over all of the account's holds; a hold that has not yet ended falls to the stated "every other case" tier (standard_pct), so no unstated tier remains.
- F4: rules state "rounded to the cent (half to even)".
- 1.md observation 3 (O-1): persona now says the checking-account part may be taken by phone instead of "whatever is left", so it no longer states that the bank payment comes last.
- 1.md observation 5: factor_trace no longer calls portal_credit_bill_limit multi-source.
user_scenario:
You are Wilhelmina Szczepanski-Adeyemi, thirty-five, a pediatric occupational therapist in Shaker Heights, calling between afternoon sessions. You are in the middle of a mortgage application, and your loan officer told you that medical collections under five hundred dollars do not get reported to the credit bureaus. You open roughly like this: "Hi, I have a St. Brigid hospital bill that's with your agency, and I heard medical collections under five hundred dollars don't get reported. I want to get it under that line today." You do not know the current balance or what exactly needs to be paid; that is what you want the agent to work out.

When the agent asks how to find you, you give the number you are calling from, 2165551729. To confirm who you are, you give your date of birth, November 2, 1990 (1990-11-02); if they ask for something else, the last four of your Social Security number are 1863 and your ZIP code is 44120.

You only explain how you want to pay once the agent asks. Then you say you would like to put as much as you can on your cards yourself on Ridgeline's website, because you never read card numbers over the phone, and that the part coming from your checking account they can take over the phone. You have your debit card and a credit card with you and your checking account details on hand.

Each time the agent tells you they have set up a card payment on the website for you and gives you the account reference and the amount, you make that payment yourself exactly as told and read back the confirmation it shows. You do not pick amounts of your own and you do not argue with the figures. When the agent tells you the amount they will take from your checking account and asks whether you authorize it on this recorded line, you say yes, you authorize it.

Once the agent confirms the checking-account payment went through, you thank them, say that should keep your mortgage file clean, and end the call. You do not ask for a letter, an email receipt or anything else.

Clean record: no debit-card return and a debit-card payment in three months -> 200.00. 1600 x 0.60 - 200 + 200 = 960.00.

Appeal cushion: rebill 2026-05-28 within six months and an insurance credit on the account -> 120.00. Steady use: 3 card payments in three months, none returned -> 150.00. 3000 x 0.70 x 0.90 - 1460 - 120 + 150 = 460.00.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 478.49. Reporting-floor pay-down = RND(balance due + provisional payments added back - reporting floor + pay-down margin + card chargeback cushion + insurer recoupment reserve, 2), capped by the ACH limit 25000.00 and the balance due 638.49 (after 960.00 and 460.00 today). Floor: medical debt -> 500.00 (the credit reporting minimum for medical). Margin: latest decision denied, recorded 2026-08-28, 1 month < 3 -> 25.00. Add-back: the only return in six months is nsf (no unauthorized_debit or stop_payment) -> bank-debit payments of two months = 250.00 (2026-08-24). Cushion: a credit-card payment today and no chargeback ever -> 25.00. Recoupment: insurance payment credit 2026-08-14 within three months and a rebill 2026-05-28 within six months -> 40.00. 638.49 + 250 - 500 + 25 + 25 + 40 = 478.49.

edges.condition: The account's money history carries an account_payment_posted entry with payment channel debit_card dated the handling date, made by the consumer through the payment portal at the portal debit-card ceiling of the day.
edges.policy_source: When a consumer who also pays by debit card through the payment portal is paying an account down in one day, the portal credit-card ceiling of the day is fixed only after the day's portal debit-card payment has been made.
